AWI-ESM 1 REcoM (2024): 
aerosol: none
atmos: ECHAM6.3.04p1 (T63L47 native atmosphere T63 gaussian grid; 192 x 96 longitude/latitude; 47 levels; top level 80 km)
atmosChem: none
land: JSBACH 3.20 with dynamic vegetation
landIce: none
ocean: FESOM 1.4 (unstructured grid in the horizontal with 126859 wet nodes; 46 levels; top grid cell 0-5 m)
ocnBgchem: REcoM2 (same grid as ocean component)
seaIce: FESOM 1.4 (same grid as ocean component)
institution: Alfred Wegener Institute, Helmholtz Centre for Polar and Marine Research, Am Handelshafen 12, 27570 Bremerhaven, Germany
experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past
grid: All grid attributes are set for the native grid and based on information from attribute source.
references:
Hauck, J., C. Völker, T. Wang, M. Hoppema, M. Losch, and D. A. Wolf-Gladrow (2013), Seasonally different carbon flux changes in the Southern Ocean in response to the southern annular mode, Global Biogeochem. Cycles, 27, 1236-1245, doi:10.1002/2013GB004600.
Schourup-Kristensen, V., Sidorenko, D., Wolf-Gladrow, D. A., and Völker, C.: A skill assessment of the biogeochemical model REcoM2 coupled to the Finite Element Sea Ice–Ocean Model (FESOM 1.3), Geosci. Model Dev., 7, 2769–2802, https://doi.org/10.5194/gmd-7-2769-2014, 2014.
Semmler, T., Danilov, S., Gierz, P., Goessling, H. F., Hegewald, J., Hinrichs, C., et al. (2020). Simulations for CMIP6 with the AWI climate model AWI-CM-1-1. Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems, 12, e2019MS002009. https://doi.org/10.1029/2019MS002009
